subject: Next steps & procurement info for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Alvarez <c.alvarez@aurorapayments.com>, Janelle Ortiz <j.ortiz@aurorapayments.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & procurement info for Redwood pilot

Hi Carlos/Janelle —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the pilot and procurement moving: 

Call recap:
- Pilot scope: 2 LLM endpoints (chat + embeddings) for customer support triage (up to 10k monthly active requests)
- Success criteria: 20% reduction in average response time, stable P95 latency < 300ms, and cost target under $X per 1k requests (we'll confirm once we see sample traffic)

Requested from your side:
1) Procurement point-of-contact + vendor onboarding steps (forms, PO cadence, required tax docs)
2) Any legal/infosec questionnaires we should expect (e.g., vendor risk questionnaire, SOC2 evidence)
3) Target PO & invoicing timeline — do you operate on 30/60 day net terms, and is PO required before we start the pilot?

Attachments: procurement-checklist.pdf (basic list of items we commonly see from customers to speed onboarding).

Next steps I propose:
- Carlos/Priya: Share procurement contact and vendor portal link (if applicable) — by EOD Friday 8/7
- We'll send a draft SOW + initial pricing and sample invoice details for your finance team to review (target by Mon 8/9)
- Optional: 30-min procurement-only call next week if it helps align interneal approvers

Looping in Neha (SE) who will handle any technical questions and Dev (Legal) to help capture contract/redline expectations.

Happy to adjust cadence — thanks again, excited to get Aurora set up.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

From: Carlos Alvarez <c.alvarez@aurorapayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Janelle Ortiz <j.ortiz@aurorapayments.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@aurorapayments.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & procurement info for Redwood pilot

Marissa —

Great summary, thanks. Quick answers from our side:

- Procurement POC: Priya Menon (cc'd) will own vendor onboarding and POs.
- Vendor onboarding: We use an internal vendor portal where suppliers complete a form and upload W-9 + insurance certs. I'll drop the portal link and the form in the next email.
- PO timing: Typical timeline is ~2-4 weeks from vendor form completion to first PO. For pilots, we sometimes approve an initial PO or an MSA addendum; final terms depend on legal review.
- Payment terms: Aurora standard is Net 45, but we can discuss Net 30 for pilots if finance agrees.

Requests from procurement/legal:
1) W-9
2) Completed vendor onboarding form
3) Draft SOW and invoice details

We are good with the proposed milestones. If you can get the draft SOW and invoice example to us by Mon (8/9), I'll route it to finance.

Thanks — CC'ing Priya to follow up with the portal and form.

Carlos Alvarez
Head of Partnerships | Aurora Payments
c.alvarez@aurorapayments.com | +1 (617) 555-2233

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@aurorapayments.com>, Carlos Alvarez <c.alvarez@aurorapayments.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & procurement info for Redwood pilot

Hi Priya/Carlos —

Attached: SOW-Aurora-Redwood-v1.pdf (draft) and a short example invoice layout to make it easy for your finance team. The SOW is intentionally concise — pilot runs for 6 weeks, includes monitoring/observability access, and a one-time onboarding fee + usage-based charges.

Quick notes:
- Tax docs: W-9 will be attached in the final vendor packet (we can provide immediately)
- Invoicing: We can invoice monthly with itemized token/usage lines. For the pilot we can issue a pro forma invoice if you need a PO before usage begins.
- Contract/legal: Looping Dev for high-level approvals and to discuss an MSA vs pilot addendum.

Next steps suggested:
- Priya: Send vendor form link and any special fields to watch for (vendor ID, tax ID requirements)
- I'll follow up after you send the vendor form with completed W-9 and the pro forma invoice if that helps speed PO approval
- If helpful, schedule a 30-min procurement + legal call this week — I'm available Wed/Thu morning PT.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & procurement info for Redwood pilot

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the SOW. Attached is the Aurora vendor onboarding form (Aurora_vendor_form.pdf). Please complete and upload to our portal: https://vendor.aurorapayments.com/onboarding/form/8932. We also need a completed W-9 and our finance team prefers a sample invoice showing quantity/pricing lines.

Timeline expectations: once the portal submission is complete + W-9 received, procurement usually turns the first PO in 7-14 business days. If legal flags anything in the SOW, that can extend the timeline (we will flag early).

We prefer that onboarding docs come from the vendor (Redwood) directly rather than a partner — please upload the docs from your company account.

If you'd like, we can do a procurement-only 30-min call Thurs 8/14 9:00 AM PT to walk through the portal fields and answer finance-specific questions.

Best,

Priya Menon
Procurement Manager | Aurora Payments
priya.menon@aurorapayments.com | +1 (212) 555-0189
